title: CBDT Revises Administrative Subordination for Income Tax Appellate Authorities
content:
# CBDT Revises Administrative Subordination for Income Tax Appellate Authorities

Ek important update hai for all tax professionals and assessees! The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ne Income-tax (Appeals) authorities ki administrative subordination revise kar di hai under the new Income-tax Act, 2025.

CBDT ne Notification No. 133/2026, dated September 30, 2026, issue kiya hai.

**Kya hai is update mein?**

*   This notification amends an earlier CBDT notification (S.O. 359 dated March 30, 1988) by substituting a clause related to the administrative hierarchy.
*   Ab, Joint Commissioners of Income-tax (Appeals) aur Additional Commissioners of Income-tax (Appeals) ko Principal Chief Commissioners of Income-tax ya Chief Commissioners of Income-tax ke subordinate kar diya gaya hai.
*   This subordination will be based on the jurisdiction within which these appellate authorities perform their functions.
*   Yeh change Income-tax Act, 2025 ke Section 238 ke powers exercise karte hue kiya gaya hai.
*   The amendment is effective from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette (S.O. 5368(E)).
